same_request_control: Two root-only closed-fact controls have identical request bytes but distinct raw responses; no additional independence inferred.
limits: Direct references are immutable local content copies, not authenticated signatures or approved training labels.
Nested physical source paths require the separately preserved source/CAS evidence; this audit does not reclassify every nested source record as a direct immutable reference.
Bilingual inline identifiers and reviewed targets are checked, not a generic proof of semantic equivalence.
Datasets V1/V2/V3 stay intact as dated earlier source cuts; language, version and category overlaps are not independent examples.
